newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Orient Airlines Association changes name.
newsitem.headline: Orient Airlines Association changes name.

text.p: The Orient Airlines Association (OAA) has changed its name to the Association of Asia Pacific Airlines or AAPA, a statement from its Manila headquarters said.
AAPA Director General Richard Stirland, said the new name is a much more accurate reflection of the region where member airlines are based.
The change was approved last November but as a registered non-profit organisation in the Philippines, amended articles of association had to be approved by the Securities and Exchange Commission.

The 18 AAPA member airlines are: Air New Zealand, Air Nuigini, All Nippon Airways, Ansett Australia, Asiana Airlines, Cathay Pacific Airways, China Airlines, Hong Kong Dragon Airlines (Dragonair), EVA Air, Garuda Indonesia, Japan Airlines, Korean Air, Malaysia Airlines, Philippine Airlines, Qantas Airways, Royal Brunei Airlines, Singapore Airlines and Thai Airways International. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel +44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017
